expected.charges: Triple murder in the June 17, 1966 shooting at the Lafayette Bar and Grill in Paterson, New Jersey.
expected.sentence:
Life imprisonment; served roughly 19 years before being freed when the convictions were overturned in November 1985.

Verdict as recorded: Convicted of triple murder in 1967 and again at a 1976 retrial; sentenced to life. The convictions were overturned by federal Judge H. Lee Sarokin in November 1985, and the charges were dismissed in 1988.

Charges as recorded: Triple murder in the June 17, 1966 shooting at the Lafayette Bar and Grill in Paterson, New Jersey — a conviction widely condemned as a racist frame-up (no forensic evidence; the two key witnesses recanted; the federal courts found the prosecution had appealed to racism and concealed evidence).

updates.sentence:
